important_limitations: 100 percent source-fact coverage means every validated upstream fact is represented structurally; it does not mean every clinical statement is medically correct.
The HITL approval test used a simulated workflow reviewer and was not approval by a licensed clinician.
Clinical correctness still depends on upstream ASR and clinical-fact extraction quality.
Negation recall in the upstream clinical extraction stage was 44 percent, which supports the need for mandatory human review.
final_pipeline: Audio -> Whisper Large-v3 -> Qwen3-8B clinical extraction -> deterministic extraction validation -> Qwen3-8B SOAP draft -> deterministic SOAP validation -> human review -> approved record
